Usage: astryx blog [options] [slug]

Read the Astryx blog from the published feed

Options:
  -h, --help  display help for command

Exit codes:
  0  success
  1  unknown slug, or the feed or a post cannot be fetched

Examples:
  # List posts
  npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 blog
  # Read one post
  npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 blog introducing-astryx --json

More: npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 docs cli/commands/blog
